note: posterize rounds each channel down instead of to the nearer level, so 0.6 of two levels becomes 0, caught by ColorMapTests.posterizeTwoLevels
threshold compares the red channel instead of the luma, so pure red turns white, caught by ColorMapTests.thresholdOnLuma

gradientMap interpolates by the raw luma instead of the position between the two stops, so luma 0.375 on stops at 0.25 and 0.5 is not the half mix, caught by ColorMapTests.threeStopsInterpolateAndHold
threshold splits strictly above the level, so an encoded grey of exactly 0.5 turns black at level 0.5, caught by ColorMapTests.thresholdOnLuma
invert drops the finite clamp, so a finite pixel whose alpha minus colour overflows inverts to infinity, caught by ColorMapTests.invertStaysFinite
